description: Fabric mod that keeps crops growing while chunks are unloaded by simulating missed random ticks on return, via a throttled update queue.

mods.name: Agrarian Reform
mods.description: Agrarian Reform: The Living Earth. A pastoral immersion mod featuring persistent offline crop growth (The Continuum), advanced soil resilience (Leather Boot/Feather Falling trample protection), dynamic hydro-dynamics (extended source irrigation / rain hydration), and polyculture biodiversity growth bonuses. Part of the Instant Gratification collection.
